lines.en: Six thin legs walk along the leaf veins

lines.zh: 翅膀叠在背上，像一片薄纱
lines.en: My wings fold over my back like thin gauze

lines.zh: 我从一片叶子走到另一片
lines.en: I walk from one leaf to the next

lines.zh: 丛林里的光，从叶隙漏下来
lines.en: The jungle light leaks down through the leaves
My steps are so light the leaf does not stir
I creep along the branch slowly
The moss is soft, like walking on cotton

lines.zh: 我绕开一只更大的虫子
lines.en: I walk around a bigger insect
Every facet of my eyes is green
I reach the leaf tip and pause

lines.zh: 露水在叶面上，我绕着走
lines.en: There is dew on the leaf, I go around it
A gust comes and the leaf and I sway together
I crawl toward the sunlit side

lines.zh: 半透明的翅膀收得很紧
lines.en: My translucent wings are held tight

lines.zh: 我从森林这头走到那头，走了很久
lines.en: I have walked from one edge of the forest to the other
My antennae test the way ahead

lines.zh: 我停在叶背，谁都看不见
lines.en: I rest on the underside of a leaf, unseen
My wings are still, like a film
My antennae move little by little
There is just enough shade here
I wait for the light to fade

lines.zh: 脚下的叶脉是绿色的河
lines.en: The veins beneath me are green rivers
So small the wind does not bother with me
I press myself flat
The jungle is loud, I make no sound

lines.zh: 我的影子落在叶面上，很淡
lines.en: My shadow on the leaf is faint

lines.zh: 一动不动的本事，我最好
lines.en: Staying still is what I do best
I wait for something smaller to pass
Your face is enormous
I look up, you are like a mountain
You are in front of the light
I am this small, can you see me clearly
Do not touch me with your hand, my wings tear
I duck further under the leaf

lines.zh: 你的呼吸把我吹得歪了
lines.en: Your breath blows me off balance

lines.zh: 我抬了抬触角，算打招呼
lines.en: I lift my antennae as a greeting

lines.zh: 森林里居然有人停下来看我
lines.en: Someone in the forest actually stopped to look

lines.zh: 你走开一点，我才有地方站
lines.en: Step back a bit and I will have room to stand
A corner of my wing is torn
It hurts, I curl into a ball
A body this small can still hurt
Some dust has come off my wings
One leg on this side is lame

lines.zh: 我歪歪扭扭飞了一小段
lines.en: I flew a short, wobbly stretch
I cling to the leaf and dare not move
That will take me a long while to recover from

lines.zh: 我掉了下去，又抓住叶缘
lines.en: I fell and caught the leaf edge
I am too small to take hits

lines.zh: 你手心里那点东西，我不认得
lines.en: I do not know what is in your palm
I take one step closer, then back

lines.zh: 我这嘴很小，吃不了多少
lines.en: My mouth is tiny, I cannot eat much

lines.zh: 你举得那么高，我够不着
lines.en: You hold it so high, I cannot reach
The smell is a little strange

lines.zh: 我停在半空看了一会儿
lines.en: I hover a moment to look

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，你也拿来
lines.en: So small a thing, and you bring it out

lines.zh: 我伸出前腿，碰了一下就缩回。
lines.en: I reach out one foreleg, touch it, and pull back.
Not my food, I will not touch it
Open your fingers a little

lines.zh: 你的指尖碰过来，我翻了个跟头。
lines.en: Your fingertip nudges me and I tumble head over heels.
My wing bent, it still works

lines.zh: 你这么重，我只是片叶子
lines.en: You are so heavy, I am only a leaf

lines.zh: 我贴在你的袖子上被带走了
lines.en: I stuck to your sleeve and was carried off
Do not push, my legs are thin
I retreat to the leaf edge to steady
At that I took off and dodged

lines.zh: 你的手指比我的身子还粗
lines.en: Your finger is thicker than my body

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，翅膀上的粉掉了一点
lines.en: I shake and a little wing dust falls
Gently, I cannot take a second one

lines.zh: 这种事儿，我活不了太久
lines.en: Such things, my life is short

lines.zh: 我在林子里找过，没找到
lines.en: I have looked in the forest, found none

lines.zh: 翅膀的颜色不对，就不是
lines.en: Wrong wing color, then no
I flew a circle and shed some dust

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，也不着急
lines.en: So small a creature, no need to hurry
There are too few of my kind in this forest
I rest on a leaf and look a long while
To find one, there must be leaves first
I smelled around a long while, then flew off
A short life means moving quickly

lines.zh: 一小片东西落在我面前
lines.en: A tiny scrap has landed in front of me
I scoop it up with my front legs
For my size, it is heavy
I try to drag it, it will not move
This is not a leaf, it cannot be eaten
I push it aside

lines.zh: 这么亮的东西，森林里少见
lines.en: Something this bright is rare in the forest
I hold it a while, then let it go
My legs are too thin to hold it
It landed on the leaf, let me look first

lines.zh: 有什么东西在动，我看见了
lines.en: Something moved, I saw it
I lift my head and my antennae point

lines.zh: 这么小的身体，也只能盯
lines.en: With a body this small, watching is all I can do
I fly up a little
Something is off, I hide first
You are over there, I am over here
I go around to the back of the leaf
I do not plan to go meet it
There are no other insects left on this tree
I have drawn all six legs tight
Now I see, it is that big one
I flew out a short distance
I watch, but I do not move

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，跑也跑不远
lines.en: So small, I could not run far
I cling to the leaf's back and shift slowly
Green leaves are the best cover

lines.zh: 我顺着叶背，绕到它的背面。
lines.en: I slip along the leaf's underside, around to its back.
One step closer and I fly
My wings stay ready
I keep silent, sound would finish me
This distance is just right
I back down along the leaf stalk

lines.zh: 你的眼睛对着我这片叶子。
lines.en: Your eyes are fixed on my leaf.
Then let us both wait it out

lines.zh: 我撞了过去，然后被弹开
lines.en: I bumped into it and bounced off
My legs caught at it once

lines.zh: 这么小的力气，也算出手
lines.en: So little force, and still a strike
I bit it, and could not bite through
My wings brushed your face, lightly
I push you, and you do not move
I charge with everything I have

lines.zh: 你被我这下吓了一跳吧
lines.en: That startled you, did it not

lines.zh: 我落到你手上，抓了一把
lines.en: I landed on your hand and grabbed

lines.zh: 这就是我能做的全部了
lines.en: That is all I can do
A small point has appeared in the jungle
I crawl out from between the leaves

lines.zh: 翅膀一展开，光就透过来
lines.en: My wings open and the light comes through
I land on the leaf, very lightly
A thin shadow has joined the forest

lines.zh: 我抖了抖刚晾干的翅膀
lines.en: I shake my freshly dried wings
There is just room on this tree
I drift down from above
The wind brought me here

lines.zh: 一片叶子响了一下，是我
lines.en: A leaf rustled, that was me
The heat washed over me and my wings curled
I fell off the leaf
The dew was deeper than I thought
The blast blew me far away

lines.zh: 一支箭的风就把我掀翻了
lines.en: The wind of an arrow flipped me over

lines.zh: 那股力气让我翅膀发麻
lines.en: That force made my wings go numb
The leaves are dry, there is nothing to eat
The thunder was so loud I did not move for a long while
There are no leaves to grab here
